{{Quote|They raid our mines!|The villager expresses anger towards Tusken Raiders|<ref name="Chapter 9" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''villager''' resided in the [[Tatooine|Tatooinian]] town of [[Freetown|Mos Pelgo]] during the [[New Republic era]]. Following the [[Galactic Civil War]], he bore witness to a feud between the people of his village and a group of [[Homeworld|indigenous]] [[Tusken Raider]]s.<ref name="Chapter 9" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|9}}</ref> these tensions came to a head when Mos Pelgo's [[marshal]], [[Cobb Vanth]], brokered a truce between the villagers and the Tuskens in order to band together and kill a [[krayt dragon]] that plagued both groups. The villager voiced his repulsion to the idea, angered that the Tuskens had raided the small town's mines in the past.<ref name="Chapter 9" />

Later, while loading explosive devices onto the Raiders' [[bantha]] mounts, the villager entered into an altercation with a Tusken, who accidentally dropped one of the charges. At the behest of Vanth, however, the man dropped the subject. Together, the two groups were eventually able to take down the dragon with the help of the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]].<ref name="Chapter 9" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The villager appeared in the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|premiere]] of the [[2019]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 9" /> which aired on [[October 30]], [[2020]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Airdate">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-october-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in October 2020}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Dieterich Gray]].<ref name="Chapter 9" />
